scope: Raw review response parsing and durable replay
found_issue: Generic business text extraction removed fences or unwrapped answer/content/text before strict review validation. The journal also persisted repaired text. A fenced review and a review string hidden in an answer object with extra action metadata reached model_reviewed.
resolution: Review parsing and journaling now use original selected content text. API tool-call responses are rejected. Normal business answer extraction is unchanged.
production_regressions: answer wrapper with extra action key remains invalid
received fenced review remains invalid after recovery without a resend
tool_calls and legacy function_call metadata cannot approve a review
validation: 23 source-bound review tests and 56 related recovery, RunStore, short-answer and manual-delivery tests passed. Controlled offline responses do not establish real model review accuracy.
